## Problem

**S5 / `bioetl-runtime`:** Status=OK + Matrix Evidence=SCRAPING alongside selected Run ID / Gold accounting. Operators infer “completed run still scraping.” JSON intentionally separates telemetry confidence vs run accounting (DSA-05), but first screen still presents them as peer health.

## Scope

- [ ] Split **Execution Status** vs **Telemetry Confidence (SCRAPING/gap)** into non-peer cells

- [ ] Ensure SCRAPING never uses health-green semantics
- [ ] Keep stage lag timeseries contract (do not reintroduce broken state-timeline)
- [ ] Same-PR tests + panel docs

- Waterfall/Sankey
